description: Lists the six broad shopping categories WEM covers (electronics, fashion, beauty, home, sports, collectibles), each with example products, the shops WEM has read a price from in the last 14 days (busiest first, with how many shops there are in all) and the default currency (GBP). Use it to help a shopper narrow a vague request. It returns no prices, the category names are labels for the shopper, not filter values, and a shop on the list is not a promise that WEM holds a given product there: compare_offers says which shops WEM has for one product.
name: get_categories

providers.description: Shops WEM has read a price from in the last 14 days, busiest first, at most 40: one row per shop, with how many of its products WEM read. Say which shops WEM covers from this list, never from a shop's absence: it is not every shop WEM has ever held, and a shop on it may not sell the product the shopper wants (compare_offers says which shops WEM holds for one product).

products.description: Products WEM read a price for at this shop in the last 14 days.

shopCount.description: How many shops WEM read a price from in the last 14 days, listed or not. Null with an empty `providers` means the list could not be read just now, not that WEM has no shops.

title: List shopping categories
